definitions.explanation: The quality or outcome of something that has been made or done. Refers to how well something turned out.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出来|でき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出来|でき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: I did poorly on this test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ぶどう⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれて→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧、{出来|でき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: This year's grapes had favorable weather and turned out wonderfully.

notes:
Derived from the verb {出来|でき}る (to be able to; to be made). As a noun, {出来|でき} refers to the quality or outcome of something that has been made or done.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出来|でき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: turned out well, good quality
- {出来|でき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: turned out poorly
- {出来|でき}{栄|ば}え: quality of work, finished result
- {出来不出来|できふでき}: hit or miss, variable quality

USAGE:
Often used to evaluate results of cooking, tests, harvests, or creative work. The pattern {出来|でき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + adjective is the most natural way to comment on quality. Can also modify nouns: {出来|でき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (a well-made work).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧: finished product, result (emphasizes completion)
